text: Every filter you build lives in one pane, and applies at one of three levels. Let's see all of it.

Visual, page, or report — that's the reach a filter can have. And any viewer can check exactly what's affecting one visual just by hovering and selecting the filter icon — no editing, just visibility.

Lock a filter, and viewers can see it but not touch it. Hide it, and they can't see it at all — useful for cleanup filters nobody needs to know about. You can even format the pane itself to match your report's look.
And on larger reports, turn on a single Apply button — viewers make several filter changes first, and nothing re-queries until they select Apply. One setting, real performance difference.
Next: cross filtering and visual interactions — how selecting something in one visual actually ripples through the rest of the page.
